   - a horizontal side from \(2\) to \(4\),
   - two diagonal sides meeting at \(6\).

   - a horizontal side from \(1\) to \(5\),
   - a vertical side from \(5\) to \(3\),
   - a diagonal side from \(1\) to \(3\).
